response.original_title: Haralez: Noisy Beginnings of the Cradle
response.overview: Haralez: Noisy Beginnings of the Cradle is a poetic essay uncovering erased Armenian histories embedded within Istanbul’s urban landscape. Centered on the former Surp Hagop Cemetery, now buried beneath Gezi Park , the film follows the Haralez, mythological spirit-dogs who move between worlds of the living and the dead.
response.tagline: Guided by the Haralez, mythical spirit-dogs of resurrection, the film peels back layers of Istanbul to reveal its Armenian presence.
response.title: Haralez: Noisy Beginnings of the Cradle
